node.title: Coeficiente de recuperación de capacidad (ρ)
node.summary: Estimate the share of released capacity that returns to genuine contribution.

relations: The recovery coefficient turns the atrophy claim into a bounded question: how much released capacity becomes genuine contribution again for the same capability and cohort?
ρ menor que uno y la irreversibilidad son hipótesis a estimar; no asumir un techo inferior a uno ni llamar recuperación a cambiar a la persona de tarea.
A practice-based transmission programme could provide the capability-recovery arm of an HID intervention, separately from the integration fix that releases time.
Aprender otra tarea no eleva automáticamente ρ; contabilizar coste, capacidad objetivo y posible recuperación completa o nula.
Carrier availability at an activation threshold and the HID recovery coefficient answer different questions: who can respond now, and what capability returns after the architecture changes.
El protocolo HID no valida por transferencia el radar de κ ni demuestra que una crisis recupere facultades.
The preservation rationale motivates a testable question, while the HID measurement programme explicitly keeps recovery and irreversibility as hypotheses awaiting field evidence.
No presentar la palabra institucional «hallazgo» como resultado empírico de HID. Los ensayos propuestos no se han ejecutado aquí.
